name: YouTube Music
author: NZJ-Jimmy
description: Search, browse and listen to YouTube Music in YesPlayMusic.

settings.label: Cookie
settings.help: Optional. Click 'Get' to open the step-by-step Cookie guide (with music.youtube.com link) to sign in on Windows/Linux and sync your library, liked songs and playlists.

settings.label: Stream Resolver
settings.help: yt-dlp is recommended for reliable playback. Enable 'Allow running local programs' in the plugin menu after installing yt-dlp.

settings.label: yt-dlp Browser Cookies
settings.help: Pass --cookies-from-browser to yt-dlp to avoid bot checks or unlock Premium 256kbps audio.

settings.label: Content Region
settings.help: Affects recommendations, explore shelves and charts.

settings.label: Include Music Videos in Song Search
settings.help: When enabled, song searches also supplement results with YouTube music videos if few official songs match.

settings.label: Synced Lyrics Source
settings.help: Fallback to LRCLIB and KuGou (like InnerTune / OuterTune) when YouTube Music lacks time-synced lyrics.

settings.label: GitHub Project (Star to support!)
settings.help: If you find this plugin helpful, click 'Get' on the right to open the GitHub repository and give it a Star!
